verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a business-filing service that collects filer data, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only filing procedures, fees, copies and database contents, with nothing on user-controlled retention or deletion of submitted data. The 'delete the present statement' line refers to editing a form's stock clause, not data deletion, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
